scope: P16 regular transitional PPTX passive slide preview subset
implemented: Bounded shared ZIP capture and main-window command; cancelled presentation never releases unfinished native reads.
Explicit presentation order, slide/layout/master/theme inheritance and direct overrides; literal text, rect/ellipse and internal PNG/JPEG.
Real disposable Worker, closed display vocabulary, byte/EXIF checks and actual bitmap decode; no document HTML, foreignObject, CSS, script or resource URLs.
One slide at a time, fitted canvas, page selection and transient reading location; replacement prepared before old content is retired.
Exact seven-field source identity, page/resource leases, A/B/A late-event rejection, visible bitmap failure and unknown-read guards.

Ordinary unchanged default writer templates supported as explicit partial previews; recognized nonpaint metadata ignored narrowly, checked literal bullet characters preserved, auxiliary script fonts/auto-fit/known shadow and spacing limitations disclosed.
